_note: National helplines only, each checked against an official government source on 2026-10-24. A number that could not be verified is left out: 104 (state health information helpline) has no official source confirming it in Delhi, so it is not listed. Re-verify before any real deployment.

desc.en: Single national emergency number (ERSS). Works from any phone, 24x7.
desc.hi: राष्ट्रीय आपातकालीन नंबर (ERSS)। किसी भी फ़ोन से, 24x7।
desc.hinglish: Rashtriya emergency number (ERSS). Kisi bhi phone se, 24x7.

sources.name: PIB: Pan-India Emergency Number '112' launched (Ministry of Home Affairs)

desc.en: Free emergency ambulance, run by each state under the National Health Mission. Availability varies by state; 112 also reaches ambulance services.
desc.hi: मुफ़्त आपातकालीन एम्बुलेंस, हर राज्य राष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य मिशन के तहत चलाता है। उपलब्धता राज्य के हिसाब से अलग है; 112 से भी एम्बुलेंस मिलती है।
desc.hinglish: Muft emergency ambulance, har rajya National Health Mission ke tahat chalata hai. Uplabdhta rajya ke hisaab se alag hai; 112 se bhi ambulance milti hai.

sources.name: PIB: legacy emergency numbers (100 police, 108 ambulance, 101 fire) consolidated under 112

desc.hinglish: Kai bhashaon mein muft 24x7 counselling (1-800-891-4416 bhi).

sources.name: PIB: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, two years of Tele MANAS

desc.en: National 24x7 toll-free helpline for children in difficulty (Ministry of Women and Child Development).
desc.hi: मुश्किल में बच्चों के लिए राष्ट्रीय 24x7 टोल-फ्री हेल्पलाइन (महिला एवं बाल विकास मंत्रालय)।
desc.hinglish: Mushkil mein bachchon ke liye rashtriya 24x7 toll-free helpline (Mahila evam Baal Vikas Mantralay).

sources.name: PIB: Child Helpline 1098 integration with ERSS-112 (Ministry of Women and Child Development)
Ministry of Women and Child Development

desc.en: National helpline for senior citizens, 8 am to 8 pm, every day (Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment).
desc.hi: वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए राष्ट्रीय हेल्पलाइन, रोज़ सुबह 8 से रात 8 बजे (सामाजिक न्याय एवं अधिकारिता मंत्रालय)।
desc.hinglish: Senior citizens ke liye rashtriya helpline, roz subah 8 se raat 8 baje (Samajik Nyay evam Adhikarita Mantralay).

sources.name: UT Ladakh: Elderline 14567, the National Helpline for Senior Citizens
